posts.title: DHCPv6 has been broken in the Debian Installer for 10+ years
posts.description: As far as I can see, installs that require DHCPv6 have not been possible using the Debian Installer for more than 10 years. A bug has been reported but I suspect hasn't seen much attention because most people who have IPv6 use SLAAC.

posts.title: I got tired of having to look up how to list all fail2ban bans
posts.description: It's very strange that there is no simple way to look up all the IPs that are banned in all jails of `fail2ban`.

posts.title: Communication: must do better
posts.description: A nearly catastrophic incident of professional miscommunication leaves me reeling
